name: 2025-1c-recuperatorio-segundo
title: Painter Reloaded (Pintor Recargado)
description: Starting from the course's Painter solution (painter, wall, rectangular paintings, selection, left/right alignment with undo/redo history), add align-up, align-down, same-width and same-height actions on the selection, and a query returning the horizontal 'movement lines' to draw when a painting is dragged near the top or bottom edges of other paintings.

design.notes: The new alignments mirror the existing left/right command objects (undoable actions with their own preconditions), so the interesting part is generalizing the alignment hierarchy without duplicating it, and the movement-lines query is a collection/geometry exercise over Rectangle protocol (top, bottom, left, right, setOrigin:corner:).
